title: GEO Core Earth Sciences Program: Virtual Office Hours
summary: Oct 6 2026 3:00PM to Oct 6 2026 4:30PM EDT Program Officers from the NSF Directorate for Geosciences (NSF GEO) will discuss the GEO Core funding opportunity, focusing on one of its three programs in each session. All three sessions will start with the same information about the GEO Core opportunity, but then focus on the AGS, EAR, or OCE program with time for questions and answers. To see a previous NSF GEO office hours focusing on the entire GEO Core funding opportunity, visit the event page for the … More at https://www.nsf.gov/events/nsf-geo-atmospheric-geospace-earth-ocean-sciences-programs
